verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server that connects to MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor. It offers both a recommended remote-hosted server and a local server, configurable through query parameters and environment variables. Documented tasks range from campaign creation to flow performance reports, and a probe confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and detail on the exposed tool set and authentication flow.
